keyboardBatting: W/A/S/D: move the bat contact point inside the zone · Arrow keys: launch angle and pull/push · Hold K to load, release to swing · J: bunt · Q: power swing · E: contact swing
touchBatting: Left pad: bat contact point · Right pad: launch angle and direction · Hold the swing button and release at the plate · Bunt, power and contact buttons sit between the pads
keyboardGeneric: W/A/S/D: move · Arrow keys: aim · Hold K to charge, release to act · J: secondary action · Q/E: jump / crouch · Tab: switch player
keyboardTarget: Arrow keys: aim · Hold K to charge power, release to shoot · J: reset aim
touchGeneric: Left pad moves, right pad aims; hold the main button and release. Buttons stay directly under the scene.
controlsHere: Two-hand controls stay right under the scene.
rule_basketball5: Full-court 5-on-5 practice. Attack the far hoop: 2 points inside the arc, 3 outside; the defence attacks the other way. Hold K to charge a shot and release near the marker; J passes; Q jumps; Tab switches player.
rule_field-hockey: 5-a-side hockey practice. Keep the ball on your stick, pass with J and shoot low with K from inside the shooting circle. Opponents can steal when they are close.
rule_water-polo: 4-a-side pool practice. Players swim slowly, so pass early (J) and throw at the small goal with K. Hold crouch to press the ball carrier.
rule_softball: Underhand pitching from a shorter circle with a larger ball. Move the bat contact point to the pitch, hold K and release when the ball reaches the plate. Hits score 1–4 practice points.
rule_beach-volleyball: 2-on-2 on sand. Move under the ball, release K to attack over the net or J for a soft lob. Points when the ball touches the sand on the other side.
rule_golf: Aim with the right pad, hold K to set power, release to swing. Fewer strokes to the hole score more; a hole-in-one is 10 points. Wind is shown on screen.
rule_cricket: The bowler's delivery bounces once before it reaches you. Move the bat to the line of the ball, hold K and release at the crease. Runs by distance, 4 for a boundary, 6 over the rope; miss the ball and hit the stumps and you are bowled.
rule_sepak-takraw: 3-on-3 kick volleyball. Position under the ball and release K to kick it over the net, or J for a controlled lift. The ball may not touch the ground on your side.
rule_squash: Hit the ball onto the front wall above the tin. Return it before the second bounce; the opponent must do the same. A point ends each rally.
rule_lacrosse: 5-a-side stick practice. Cradle the ball, pass with J and shoot with K at the small netted goal. Defenders can check the ball carrier.
rule_bowling: Aim with the right pad, hold K to set speed and release. Pins knocked down score; a strike is all ten. Spin with the left pad.
rule_soft-tennis: 2-on-2 with a soft rubber ball that bounces high and slow. Release K for a drive, J for a lob. One bounce before every return.
rule_billiards: Aim with the right pad, hold K for power and release to strike the cue ball. Pocket object balls for points; pocketing the cue ball is a scratch.
rule_flag-football: 5-a-side non-contact football. Run or pass (J) toward the end zone; a defender pulling your flag ends the play. 6 practice points per touchdown.
coachApprentice: Ask the coach (generative AI on your device)
coachOffline: Basic coach – fixed tips, not generative AI
orientationTip: Landscape gives the widest arena; portrait keeps the controls closest to your thumbs.
